title: EFC Euclid DR1 Boltzmann Pre-Registration
description: Pre-registered, frozen predictions for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) to be tested against Euclid DR1, computed via full Boltzmann integration in hi_class with a custom efc_logistic Horndeski implementation. At the benchmark (B0=0.02, M0=0.06), five linear observables exhibit a coherent growth–lensing pattern (e.g., σ8 up, C_ell^{ϕϕ} down) that is hashed for integrity and claimed to be distinct from known systematics or massive neutrino effects.
author: Morten Magnusson

entropy_sigmoid.description: Late-time entropy field that gates EFC modifications; S → 0 at high redshift and transitions near a_t with sharpness Δ.

alphaB.description: Braiding function driven by the slope of the entropy sigmoid; controls kinetic mixing in Horndeski perturbations.

alphaM.description: Planck-mass running proportional to the entropy activation; sources time-varying gravitational potentials.

alphaT.description: Tensor speed fixed to the speed of light in accordance with GW170817 constraints.

slip_eta.description: Gravitational slip parameter; EFC predicts \eta > 1 at late times, indicating unequal metric potentials.

EG_statistic.description: Scale-dependent slip test combining galaxy–lensing and galaxy–galaxy angular spectra; leading-order bias cancels, leaving residual dependence via \beta.

stability_conditions.description: Horndeski scalar-sector gradient and no-ghost stability conditions satisfied in the stated benchmark region.

key_results.main_finding: At (B0, M0) = (0.02, 0.06), EFC predicts a coherent five-observable signature decoupling growth and lensing (e.g., σ8 +1.21%, C_ell^{ϕϕ}(ℓ=66) −6.01%), sealed by a SHA-256 hash for Euclid DR1 falsification.
datasets_used: None (sealed pre-registration; background set to Planck 2018 best-fit)

sealed_predictions.statement: σ8 is increased by +1.21% relative to ΛCDM at the benchmark.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Euclid DR1 growth measurements (e.g., RSD and clustering amplitudes) showing σ8 consistent with ΛCDM within ≤1% at 2σ.

sealed_predictions.statement: P(k=0.05 h/Mpc, z=0.5) is increased by +2.09% relative to ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Euclid DR1 galaxy clustering P(k) near k≈0.05 h/Mpc at z≈0.5 (with survey window convolution) consistent with ΛCDM within the quoted amplitude at ≥2σ.

sealed_predictions.statement: C_ell^{ϕϕ} (lensing potential) at ℓ=66 is decreased by −6.01% relative to ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Euclid DR1 tomographic weak-lensing power (κκ) and/or CMB lensing reconstructions near ℓ≈66 inconsistent with a ≈−6% shift at ≥2σ after window-function effects.

sealed_predictions.statement: E_G(ℓ=66) is decreased by −3.98% relative to ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Euclid DR1 joint galaxy–lensing and RSD analysis of E_G at ℓ≈66 consistent with ΛCDM within 1% at 2σ (including systematics).

sealed_predictions.statement: C_ell^{TT} (ISW-dominated) at ℓ=30 is increased by +1.88% relative to ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Planck low-ℓ TT (and Euclid ISW–LSS cross-correlations) rejecting a positive ≈+2% shift at ≥2σ.

kill_criteria: KC1: Euclid DR1 measures |E_G(ℓ≈66) − E_G^ΛCDM| < 1% at 2σ (including systematics), i.e., consistent with zero shift—this falsifies the EFC benchmark coupling.
KC2: Any of the five sealed observables shows an opposite-sign shift relative to ΛCDM at ≥2σ after Euclid DR1 window/convolution corrections.
KC3: The joint Euclid DR1 growth and lensing analysis finds the growth and lensing sectors shift with the same sign near k≈0.05 h/Mpc (or ℓ≈66) at ≥2σ, violating the EFC coherence property.
KC4: Independent reproduction with hi_class (including the supplied efc_logistic implementation) reveals violation of Horndeski stability (c_s^2 ≤ 0 or Q_S ≤ 0) on 0 < z < 3 for the stated benchmark.

ledger_impact.holistic_analysis: This paper establishes the first full Boltzmann-level sealed prediction set for EFC against Euclid DR1, computed via hi_class with a custom Horndeski implementation. It freezes five coherent observables (σ8, P(k), C_ℓ^{ϕϕ}, E_G, C_ℓ^{TT} ISW) with SHA-256 integrity, creating an immutable pre-registration record months before the October 2026 data release. This is the single most important strategic move for EFC credibility: if Euclid DR1 confirms the growth–lensing decoupling pattern, EFC passes the strongest possible test; if not, the theory is cleanly falsified at the benchmark coupling.
graph_insights: This paper is currently an isolated node in the graph (no 1-hop or 2-hop connections found), which means it needs to be linked to: (a) the Horndeski scalar-tensor concept cluster, (b) the hi_class/Boltzmann integration infrastructure node, (c) the gravitational slip / E_G observable nodes, (d) the ISW effect node, and (e) the sigma8 tension node. These links will make it a high-centrality hub connecting theory implementation to Stage-IV observational tests.

The absence of matching validation tests in the graph confirms these are genuinely new pipeline tests — the 8 tests added here (6 planned + 2 passed) should increase the test count from 119 to 127 total, with pipeline count rising from 18 to 24.

Once Euclid DR1 drops (Oct 2026), this node becomes the single highest-consequence decision point in the entire graph: it connects to 5 observables simultaneously, and a joint falsification propagates to kill the entire benchmark coupling region.

implicit_consequences: The hi_class Boltzmann pipeline is now operational and can be reused for DESI DR2 full-shape predictions — this partially de-risks the DESI rapid-response pipeline gap (bottom line biggest gap) by establishing the computational infrastructure.

The 36-configuration stability scan implicitly maps part of the EFC parameter space boundary, providing input for the full non-linear ADM Hamiltonian stability analysis (theory-adm-hamiltonian-stability) even though it only covers linear Horndeski stability.

The growth–lensing decoupling pattern (σ8 up but C_ℓ^{ϕϕ} down) is an EFC-specific fingerprint that cannot be mimicked by massive neutrinos (which suppress both), creating a clean degeneracy-breaking observable — this implicitly constrains the neutrino mass degeneracy gap (theory-neutrino-mass-degeneracy).

The E_G statistic at ℓ=66 with −3.98% shift provides a direct target for existing and upcoming spectroscopic surveys beyond Euclid (DESI, SPHEREx), meaning these predictions have cross-survey falsifiability even before Euclid DR1.

The explicit statement that EFC background expansion is identical to ΛCDM (α-gate closed) means all EFC signatures are purely perturbation-level — any detection of background-level deviation from ΛCDM (e.g., in BAO or SNe) would be orthogonal to these predictions and could not rescue the theory if the perturbation predictions fail.

The paper's four internal kill criteria (KC1–KC4 within the paper) are distinct from the project-level KC1–KC5 and represent the most aggressive self-falsification posture yet: a single opposite-sign observable at 2σ kills the benchmark.
